SOS Enterprise: engineering data-management platform that automates data governance, tagging, versioning and traceability to make semiconductor design data 'AI-ready' for enterprise-scale AI adoption and regulatory compliance.

Eggplant Test / Keysight Generator: generative-AI and model-based test-case generation that automatically creates and maintains executable software test assets, expanding coverage and detecting defects earlier. Keysight was named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner MQ for AI-Augmented Software Testing Tools.

Internal software-development use of AI coding assistance: Keysight states it uses AI for internal product development/productivity and describes using GitHub Copilot to automate repetitive coding tasks like debugging and testing. [GitHub Copilot (Microsoft/GitHub)]

AI-powered Chat (Learning Assistant) and Copilot (Tool Assistant) virtual assistants embedded in Advanced Design System (ADS) software; the on-prem Copilot executes commands in SIPro/RFPro EM simulation to automate repetitive design tasks. Learning Assistant shipped in ADS 2026 Update 1; Copilot in early-access. [On-prem language models fine-tuned on Keysight design expertise (vendor unnamed)]

AI Software Integrity Builder (AX1000A): a launched software solution for validating and maintaining AI-enabled systems in safety-critical (e.g. automotive) environments, spanning dataset analysis, model-based validation, inference-based testing and continuous monitoring for data drift.

Keysight AI (KAI) Data Center Test Platform / KAI architecture: tunable AI-workload emulation, pre-packaged benchmarking apps and dataset-analysis tools to identify performance inhibitors in large GPU deployments and validate AI/ML network fabrics at scale.

AI-for-RAN: Keysight, Samsung and NVIDIA trained and integrated an AI channel-estimation model into Samsung's vRAN software, validated with Keysight channel emulation on the NVIDIA AI Aerial platform (GH200), demonstrated end-to-end at MWC 2025. [NVIDIA (AI Aerial, GH200 Grace Hopper); Samsung]
deployments_detail.value: 30% better cell-edge throughput vs static rules-based approach

deployments_detail.use: Machine Learning Toolkit for device modeling and PDK development: ML-driven modeling that shortens design-technology co-optimization (DTCO) feedback loops between device and circuit design.
deployments_detail.value: Reduces PDK development cycles from weeks to days

deployments_detail.use: KAI Inference Builder: AI inference emulation platform (with NVIDIA Air AI-factory simulation) to validate and optimize AI inference infrastructure performance. [NVIDIA (Air AI factory simulation)]

Keysight Global Services (KTAS) deployed generative AI in its customer Support Portal / Knowledge Center for self-serve answers, plus LLM-assisted technician diagnostics and an AI classification system that routes/categorizes support cases in the right language across >100K cases/year.
deployments_detail.value: 90% of cases reach the right person the first time; KTAS customer satisfaction 90%+
